categories.main_business_segments: KISWIRE operates primarily in the wire rod industry with three main segments: Rope segment producing wire ropes; Wire segment producing high carbon steel wires including cold drawn wires and PC steel wires; and Other segment including leasing and related services. These segments cater to diverse industries such as automotive, mining, shipbuilding, and machinery.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in manufacturing high-quality wire ropes and steel wires using advanced wire drawing and processing technologies. It operates pilot research facilities for high carbon steel wire manufacturing, enabling precise product development and minimizing trial errors. The production process involves optimal machine performance, multi-shift operations, and continuous capacity enhancements to produce specialized products like high-strength ropes and PC strands.
categories.primary_customers_markets: KISWIRE serves key industrial sectors including automotive (notably tire manufacturers like Bridgestone, Continental, Michelin), shipbuilding, construction, mining, and machinery industries. Its products are used in automotive tires and parts, ship ropes, elevators, telecommunications, and high-pressure support applications. The company has a strong domestic market presence and exports globally through overseas subsidiaries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing facilities and headquarters in Busan. It has established overseas subsidiaries and production sites in the United States, Malaysia, China (Qingdao), Czech Republic, and other locations. Its sales and exports cover global markets including Europe, North America, and Asia, supported by international sales subsidiaries.
categories.supply_chain_position: KISWIRE operates mainly in the midstream segment of the steel supply chain, focusing on processing raw steel materials into specialized wire products and wire ropes. It sources raw materials like steel rods and zinc from upstream suppliers such as POSCO and Shin Nippon Steel and supplies intermediate and final products to downstream industries including automotive and construction.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-strength wire technologies, including development of OT steel wires for engine valves, high-strength suspension bridge cables, unbonded PC strands for cable-stayed bridges, and superconducting wires for fusion reactors. It maintains a dedicated central technology research center collaborating with universities and steel companies to enhance product quality and develop high value-added products. Environmental sustainability and carbon emission reduction are also strategic considerations.
categories.revenue_model: KISWIRE generates revenue primarily through product sales of wire ropes and steel wires, both domestically and internationally. Sales include export orders and domestic contracts via bidding and direct sales. The company also earns income from leasing activities and related services. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods or services to customers under contract terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: KISWIRE is the largest domestic manufacturer in South Korea for wire ropes and special steel wires, holding approximately 50% market share in ropes and 42% in wires domestically. It competes with other global and regional wire and steel producers, facing challenges from low-cost producers, especially from China. Its competitive edge lies in superior product quality and high value-added product development.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, KISWIRE reported consolidated revenues of approximately 1.79 trillion KRW, reflecting a 13.7% decline from the previous year due to challenging market conditions. Operating profit was 56.3 billion KRW, down 57.8%, and net income was 64.5 billion KRW, down 30.1%. The company maintains a strong capital base with total assets of 2.45 trillion KRW and equity ratio of 73.2%, showing stable financial health despite revenue contraction.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KISWIRE emphasizes high product quality, technological innovation, and reliability as its core value propositions. It offers high-strength, specialized wire products such as high-performance wire ropes and PC strands that meet stringent international standards and certifications. The company focuses on developing high value-added products to differentiate from low-cost competitors and sustain profitability in a competitive global market.
